purpose: One table of addresses, replayed through both implementations of the permission parser. The editor reads an address to build the prompt a person answers (apps/desktop/src/url.ts); the runtime reads the same address to decide whether the request is allowed (crates/encastra-builtins/src/net.rs). Two parsers for one string is a deliberate duplication — the editor cannot call into the runtime — and what makes it safe is that they agree. Nothing was checking that they did. An `authority` of null means the address is refused: there is nothing to ask permission for.
